drhp.business: Nimbus Projects Limited is engaged in the construction of residential flats through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) that have been allotted plots of land on long-term lease under the Builders Residential Scheme (BRS) of NOIDA, GNIDA and the Yamuna Expressway Authority (YEA). The company develops both wholly-owned projects and projects through partnership firms with joint-control partners, spanning new launches, ongoing developments and completed handover-stage projects across Noida, Greater Noida and the Yamuna Expressway corridor.
